keyword: how to file for a tax extension
claims: Form 4868 is submitted electronically or by mail by April 15, 2026 to obtain an extension until October 15, 2026 to file taxes.
Selecting "Extension" as the reason when paying estimated taxes owed online using IRS Direct Pay automatically files Form 4868.
A tax extension gives more time to file paperwork but not more time to pay money owed.
Taxpayers must estimate and pay what they owe by April 15 to avoid penalties.
Form 4868 is automatically approved if filed properly and on time.
Failure to file a return or an extension by the deadline may result in a failure-to-file penalty.
IRS Free File is free software available to everyone regardless of income for filing Form 4868.
Extension payments can be made using IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or digital wallet by choosing "Extension" as the payment reason with no separate form required.
TurboTax can be used to file Form 4868.
H&R Block can be used to file Form 4868.
Form 4868 can be mailed to the IRS postmarked by April 15, 2026.
Form 4868 requires name, address, Social Security Number or ITIN.
Form 4868 requires an estimate of tax liability.
U.S. citizens or residents living outside the US and Puerto Rico get a two-month automatic extension until June 15 to file and pay without filing Form 4868.
Military personnel on duty outside the US and Puerto Rico receive an automatic two-month extension.
